desc: 纯色青蓝无印花，三层复合点焊包边，细圆耳带，日常通勤佩戴
leaf: 纯色青蓝三层平面点焊包边耳带式一次性口罩
name: 纯色青蓝点焊边三层耳带口罩款

shots.intent: 首屏用冷灰纸质看板加缎面衬底立住「干净、克制、成人向」的第一印象，一眼看清纯色青蓝点焊边平面口罩本体。
shots.textZone: left column: letterspaced Latin kicker, headline plus one sub-line; a row of petrol badges beneath

shots.intent: 把换口罩的理由落在一天里四个可见的扬尘瞬间，用横向时间轴讲环境困扰，不碰任何病理与感染叙事。
shots.textZone: headline across the top, one ordinal badge plus one short label under each of the four slots

shots.intent: 高机位拍复合布层的层间剖面，用序号徽章把三层用料一一对应到布名，讲清成本结构而不给任何效率数字。
shots.textZone: headline top-left, three ordinal badges plus three material labels down the right column

shots.intent: 两张同框贴纸卡等比对照单层薄布与三层复合本体，把用料差异转成可看的手感与挺度差别。
shots.textZone: two column headers and two badges per column

shots.intent: 微距呈现四边密点超声焊与布面压点的规整排布，回应开边、掉点与做工疑虑。
shots.textZone: one petrol badge plus one short label in a lower corner

shots.intent: 用两格产品自说明的佩戴步骤消解尺寸与戴法疑虑，全程不出现人物，规避手部与脸部穿帮。
shots.textZone: headline above, one ordinal badge plus one short step line inside each panel

shots.intent: 高机位俯拍背影肩头，让成人通勤人群代入日常佩戴形态，人物匿名且不见任何医疗环境。
shots.textZone: clean upper zone for one headline plus one short line

shots.intent: 90 度俯视一次摊开四个纯色配色与连排折叠形态，帮买家同时判断颜色、尺寸比例与携带方式。
shots.textZone: three short badges along the bottom card band

shots.intent: 用字段化参数卡与空白资质带承接产品身份，数值与凭证一律留白待真实资料后期合成。
shots.textZone: headline top-left, five petrol field chips down the left of the card, blank value slots to the right, one blank seal band in the footer

shots.intent: 三条回顾要点加一枚短按钮收口全页，靠结构与用料完成加购转化，不依赖任何资质或数值承诺。
shots.textZone: headline above, three checklist lines with tick badges on the card, one rounded petrol button beneath

style.backgroundSystem: flat matte mist-grey boards #E9EDF1 with raised paper-white sticker cards #F8FAFC carrying one soft offset drop shadow, thin hairline rules, letterspaced uppercase Latin kickers and rotated vertical Latin section labels along a card edge; slate blue-grey panel blocks #C6D2DD used as quiet sub-zones; one pale satin-silk drape #DCE4EC reserved for the opening screen only; never a gradient plinth, never a pastel candy colour block, never a clinical or tiled space
style.iconSystem: solid rounded-square badges in deep petrol #1F5F74 with one white inner keyline #F8FAFC, each paired with an ordinal marker chip and a dot-flanked label, identical corner radius and stroke weight everywhere; never an open thin-line circle icon, never a filled disc icon inside an arch-topped card
style.lightingSystem: cool-neutral 5200K studio light, soft top-right broad key with a low flat fill, short believable card shadows falling to the lower-left, no light streak, no specular hotspot, identical direction across the whole set
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cold grey-blue editorial paper-collage ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist-grey base board #E9EDF1, paper-white card stock #F8FAFC, one slate blue-grey panel tone #C6D2DD, deep ink text #1C2B3A, and one deep petrol accent #1F5F74; cool-neutral 5200K studio light with a soft top-right broad key and a low flat fill, short card shadows falling to the lower-left, no light streak and no specular hotspot; flat matte boards with raised paper-white sticker cards carrying one soft offset drop shadow, thin hairline rules, letterspaced uppercase Latin kickers and rotated vertical Latin section labels, never a gradient plinth, never a pastel candy block, never a clinical space; neutral Chinese sans with one condensed grotesque Latin kicker; solid rounded-square petrol badges with one white inner keyline plus ordinal marker chips, never open thin-line circles and never filled disc icons in arch-topped cards; the plain sky-blue flat pleated mask keeps its three horizontal pleats, its white nose-clip strip band across the top hem with one hidden wire, its dense dot-matrix ultrasonic weld borders inside all four edges, its thin round elastic ear loops and its solid sky-blue #5FA8DC face colour with paler #A9D3EF border band, with no print and no logo; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no percentage or grade code rendered, no medical or clinical framing.
noDrift: no color palette changes
no mixed fonts
no random backgrounds
no inconsistent lighting
no mismatched icon styles
no blue gradient field or 3D stepped plinth; the ground is a flat mist-grey board with raised paper-white sticker cards
no pastel candy colour-block boards, no pink or mint scheme, no scalloped cloud edging
no warm 4300K front-right key and no 6000K top-left light streak; the set is cool-neutral 5200K with a top-right broad key
no open thin-line circle icons and no filled disc icons in arch-topped cards; icons stay solid rounded-square petrol badges
no filtration percentage of any kind and no BFE or PFE figure
no micron or particle-size figure and no electrostatic-attraction efficiency claim
no pathogen, virus, bacteria, germ or disease claim and no antibacterial or antiviral wording
no medical, surgical, clinical or isolation wording anywhere, including the reference page artwork
no standard or grade code such as KN95, N95, GB 2626, YY 0469 or EN 14683
no test report, laboratory figure, certification mark or seal text
no clinical setting, hospital, clinic or healthcare worker
no identifiable human face; any wearer is cropped above the jaw or turned away
no QR code, membership badge, contact block or price figure
no printed pattern, cartoon motif or brand wordmark added to the mask body
no altered pleat count, nose-clip shape, ear-loop construction, dot-matrix edge binding, cup form or colour
style.presentationRules: keep the flat rectangular pleated body, the three horizontal pleats, the white nose-clip strip band across the top hem with one hidden wire, the dense dot-matrix ultrasonic weld borders running inside all four edges, the thin round elastic ear loops and the solid sky-blue #5FA8DC face colour with its paler #A9D3EF border band exactly as in the reference; no print, no pattern, no logo on the body; stable angle, scale and centring in every shot
style.surfaceSystem: matte printed-paper card planes #F8FAFC over mist-grey board #E9EDF1, slate blue-grey #C6D2DD inset panels, one pale satin fabric drape #DCE4EC in the opening screen; real spun-bonded non-woven fabric texture on the product itself
style.typography: neutral Chinese sans for copy paired with one condensed grotesque Latin kicker in letterspaced uppercase; three-layer in-image copy wrapped in 「」, headline <=15 chars, two to five short badges, no dense body text, no figures rendered by the model
